verdict.rationale: Galileo documents an official MCP server that connects AI-powered IDEs such as Cursor and VS Code with GitHub Copilot to its evaluation platform. Through it, agents can create and manage datasets, run experiments and set up prompt templates. A probe independently confirmed the setup page exists. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the server working, and evidence of setup/auth details or the full tool coverage (e.g., traces/logs access).
